name: Joshua Valente
original_name: ジヨシュア・ヴァレンテ
source:
Joshua is one of the four Valente's brothers, a well-known and noble family in the makai, which controls the element of fire. He's the spoiled youngest brother and is on good terms with Faust and Aaron.
He's Algernon's childhood friend and has the innate ability to talk to animals.
translation:
Joshua is one of the four Valente's brothers, a well-known and noble family in the makai, which controls the element of fire. He's the spoiled youngest brother and is on good terms with Faust and Aaron.
